content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"Three finance-sector programmes combine basic banking, life insurance, and accident insurance as follows: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) provides basic banking through Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA) with no minimum balance requirement [E02]. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, with a premium of ₹436 per annum [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with a premium of ₹20 per annum [E03]. All three schemes are offered through banks and post offices, with premiums auto-debited from account holders' accounts, creating an integrated approach to financial security for account holders aged 18-50 years (or up to 70 for PMSBY).","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMJDY provides basic banking through BSBDA with no minimum balance requirement","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"PMJJBY offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason with premium of ₹436 per annum","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"PMSBY provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with premium of ₹20 per annum","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"All three schemes are offered through banks and post offices with auto-debit of premiums","evidence_ids":["E01","E02","E03"]}]}
